morning.caption:
A Thanksgiving storm briefly knocked out power at WSSC Water's Potomac plant while its backup was down for maintenance, putting 1.9 million Maryland customers on essential use only for the third time in 2026.

afternoon.caption:
The African Development Bank approved a €71 million loan for a wastewater treatment and reuse complex in Monastir, Tunisia, part of a €97.91 million project that will supply treated water to farms and factories.

evening.caption:
Desalination contract awards are expected to total about 4.5 million cubic meters a day in 2026, down from more than 6 million in 2025, as Gulf tenders draw fewer bidders and build costs rise, the IDRA handbook finds.
